description: Land Title Settlement Department - Damwala, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610029 (23/1200106)
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It deals specifically with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land title settlement procedures, and determinations of land ownership - all of which fall squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
